correctness.rationale: For every nonnegative row-stochastic W with a two-sign eigenvector Ls=κs (0<κ≤2), the signed initial opinions and common leadership remain an exact invariant manifold. Reconstructing the scalar flow gives y*=α/(α+βκ²), u*=aα/(α+βκ³); invariant rectangle and eventual positive u establish exponential on-manifold convergence. For exactly two symmetric agents, direct differentiation of the ORIGINAL full four-component fixed-anchor ODE, not merely the reduced map, splits longitudinal and transverse blocks; the latter has determinant a²α²(α−2βκ³)/(α+βκ³)² and negative trace. Hence local full-state sink iff α>2βκ³, exactly one unstable mode iff <, and a single zero eigenvalue at equality (nonlinear critical behaviour deliberately not asserted). Independent SymPy full-Jacobian computation matches the determinant. The two-agent restriction, a>0, common anchors and local nature are essential.
